description: chinamax session-lifecycle hooks. SessionStart injects the running/recent Job digest (and exports CHINAMAX_SESSION_ID + CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA); Stop emits a non-blocking running-Jobs notice. There is deliberately NO SessionEnd hook (ADR 0004): a Job outlives the Claude session that started it, so nothing about a session ending may touch a running worker. The clear matcher is included on purpose — /clear wipes context, exactly when inherited-Job awareness must be re-injected.
